data.title: The transcription factor TFEB links mTORC1 signaling to transcriptional control of lysosome homeostasis
data.authors: Roczniak-Ferguson A; Petit CS; Froehlich F; Qian S; Ky J; Angarola B; Walther TC; Ferguson SM

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB to control lysosomal and autophagy gene transcription.
data.abstract_excerpt: Lysosomes are the major cellular site for clearance of defective organelles and digestion of internalized material. Demand on lysosomal capacity can vary greatly, and lysosomal function must be adjusted to maintain cellular homeostasis. Here, we identified an interaction between the lysosome-localized mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) and the transcription factor TFEB, which promotes lysosome biogenesis.

extracted_findings.effect: mTORC1 controls TFEB to transcriptionally regulate lysosome biogenesis and homeostasis
